name: Cash flow forecast
description: Project 13-week cash flow from open AR, scheduled AP, payroll and recurring revenue, and flag low-balance weeks.

config.query: SELECT id, daysToCollect, amount, customer FROM transaction WHERE type = 'Invoice' AND status = 'Open'
SELECT id, daysToPay, amount, vendor FROM transaction WHERE type = 'VendorBill' AND status = 'Open'

config.script: const weeks=Array.from({length:13},(_,i)=>({week:i+1,balance:0}));for(const r of input.ar){const w=Math.min(12,Math.floor(r.daysToCollect/7));weeks[w].balance+=r.amount;}for(const r of input.ap){const w=Math.min(12,Math.floor(r.daysToPay/7));weeks[w].balance-=r.amount;}return{weeks,low:weeks.filter(w=>w.balance<input.threshold)};

name: Churn analysis
description: Decompose monthly churn by reason, contract value tier and segment; separate voluntary from involuntary.

config.query: SELECT AccountId, Reason__c, Voluntary__c FROM Churn_Survey__c

name: Collections performance
description: Track collector contact rates, promise-to-pay conversion and dollars recovered by rep weekly.

config.query: SELECT OwnerId, Type, Status, AccountId FROM Task WHERE Type IN ('Call','Email') AND CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7
SELECT id, repId, amount FROM customerPayment WHERE lastModifiedDate >= SYSDATE-7

config.script: const r={};for(const a of input.activity){r[a.OwnerId]=r[a.OwnerId]||{contacts:0,recovered:0};r[a.OwnerId].contacts+=1;}for(const p of input.payments){r[p.repId]=r[p.repId]||{contacts:0,recovered:0};r[p.repId].recovered+=p.amount;}return r;

name: Commission run
description: Pull Salesforce attainment, compute rep payouts against the comp plan and push approved payouts to Rippling.

config.query: SELECT OwnerId, Owner.Name, BasePayout__c, AttainmentPct__c FROM Quota__c WHERE Period__c = THIS_QUARTER

config.script: return input.rows.map(r => ({ rep: r.rep, payout: r.attainmentPct >= 1 ? r.basePayout * 1.1 : r.basePayout * r.attainmentPct, exception: r.attainmentPct > 1.5 }));

config.reason: Review reps exceeding 150% attainment before payroll closes.

name: Invoice aging analysis
description: Pull open invoices from NetSuite, group by aging bucket and ship a weekly summary to the controller in Slack.

config.query: SELECT id, daysPastDue, balance FROM transaction WHERE type = 'Invoice' AND status = 'Open'

config.script: const b={current:0,b30:0,b60:0,b90:0};for(const i of input.invoices){const d=i.daysPastDue||0;if(d<=0)b.current+=i.balance;else if(d<=30)b.b30+=i.balance;else if(d<=60)b.b60+=i.balance;else b.b90+=i.balance;}return b;

input.customInstructions: Extract contract value, term length, billing frequency and start date for each contract.

config.script: return input.terms.map(t => ({ contractId: t.id, monthlyRevenue: t.value / t.termMonths }));

name: Revenue waterfall
description: Group Salesforce contracts by signing quarter, compute the recognized-revenue waterfall and sync to NetSuite.

config.query: SELECT Id, ContractNumber, StartDate, ContractTerm, Amount FROM Contract WHERE Status = 'Activated'

config.script: const w={};for(const c of input.contracts){const q=c.StartDate.slice(0,7);w[q]=(w[q]||0)+c.Amount/c.ContractTerm;}return w;

name: Subscription MRR tracking
description: Pull subscription events from Stripe, classify MRR changes and push the trend to Google Sheets monthly.

config.script: const r={new:0,expansion:0,contraction:0,churn:0};for(const e of input.events){if(e.type==='customer.subscription.created')r.new+=e.amount;else if(e.delta>0)r.expansion+=e.delta;else if(e.delta<0&&!e.cancelled)r.contraction+=Math.abs(e.delta);else if(e.cancelled)r.churn+=e.amount;}return r;

description: Aggregate AP and card spend by vendor, surface maverick spending and flag contracts expiring within 90 days.

config.query: SELECT id, vendor, amount FROM vendorPayment WHERE lastModifiedDate >= SYSDATE-30

config.script: const v={};for(const r of input.ap){v[r.vendor]=(v[r.vendor]||0)+r.amount;}for(const c of input.card){v[c.vendor]=(v[c.vendor]||0)+c.amount;}return{byVendor:v};
